members.name: Chirom Meiraba
members.bio: Meiraba, a recipient of Young Scientist Award, is an enthusiastic science communicator. He maintained a good academic record since his high school days and secured 9th Position in HSLC’12. After winning the prestigious INSPIRE Fellowship, he went to IISER Kolkata to pursue BS-MS degree in Chemical Sciences where he also got exposed to teaching as a Teaching Assistant. He underwent training at various places: NTU Singapore (Global Rank 11), National Chemical Lab Pune, IIT Guwahati, and MU and finally went on to receive a DPhil admission offer from the University of Oxford, UK with OCSI Scholarship. He is also a Karateka who won Silver Medal in the Inter Districts. He is using his years of training in research to address issues of education in Manipur by leading a dedicated executive team at MitSna and as its Founder. He is a DAAD alumnus and currently at the University of Houston, Texas, US, as a doctoral candidate.
